_comment: Tier-2 for febio::biphasic_fsi#0. <Module type="biphasic-FSI"/> is killed by SIGSEGV: the fixture asserts the signal AND every absence the claim rests on — no SUCCESS!, no FAILED!, no ERROR box, no .log file, stdout stopping mid-line at 'Reading file in.feb ...'. The positive control is the shipped biphasic_fsi_3d_block template, which differs only in the module string and reaches normal termination, so the crash is attributable to that string alone.
